title: SimpleModManager
author: nadrino
details:
SimpleModManager is used for managing LayeredFS mods.

It organizes mods by game and lets you apply, remove, check, and manage mod sets directly from the console. Mods are stored under `sd:/mods/` using a game and mod directory structure before being copied into their appropriate Atmosphere locations.
